# Game Design Docs Index

Read this first. Each row tells you which doc covers which topic.

---

## Core Mechanic Specs (authoritative)

| Doc | Covers |
|-----|--------|
| contractor-system | Mission flow, cooldowns, affinity, job board UI, mission generation approach |
| contractor-mission-generation | Hybrid procedural+AI generation architecture, template structure, Claude API |
| economy-and-minerals | Francs, market pricing (L5), minerals, refinery timing, loan system |
| level-progression-and-unlocks | All unlocks by level, XP curve, mission gates, mission cap |
| mining-minigame-system | Sidescroll minigame, difficulty, planet vs asteroid, variety, depletion |
| rocket-and-room-system | Rocket lineup, per-trip purchase, slot-based rooms, StarterRocket family |
| target-system | Asteroids vs planets, depletion rules, laser tiers, proc-gen |
| construction-and-settlements | Structure types, unlock timeline (L4–L7), first-time mechanic tutorial |
| mission-system-specification | M1–M4 authored arc, free-launch mode, end-of-rocket debrief |
| user-flow-and-citizen-science | UX flow, TESS integration, personal discoveries log, scanner relevance |
| star-map-and-navigation | Sector reveal, solar system vs star systems, solar icons, personal layer |
| earth-base-visual-evolution | Earth base grows visually — extremely important retention mechanic |

---

## Deferred / Future Specs

| Doc | Covers | Revisit |
|-----|--------|----------|
| shared-discovery-consensus | Classification notifications (near-term MVP) + full multiplayer (deferred) | Partial now / ~2026-04-07 |
| characters-system-deferred | Crew roles, room assignment | 2026-03-30 |
| long-term-features-roadmap | All deferred features with dates | — |

---

## Reference / Log

| Doc | Notes |
|-----|-------|
| design-decisions-log | Compact record of all confirmed decisions — load for quick context |
| gameplay-vision-20-questions | ARCHIVED — decisions extracted, do not use |
| mission-improvement-plan | ARCHIVED — planning complete |
